leaves.name: bostLowerBoundAn
leaves.doc: r3-residual, printed form: Bost, Sem. Bourbaki 795 (Asterisque 237, 1996), h_D(A) >= -(g/2) log 2pi (display UNVERIFIED; Deligne normalization h_D = h_F + (g/2) log pi), over ZInQ.R3Residual.IsAnStableHeight: height-fix's printed stable height with the archimedean metric (i/2)^g int eta~ wedge eta~-bar integrated over the complex manifold A_tau(C)^an, i.e. with the density of the invariant form read in every holomorphic chart (IsHolChart: biholomorphic to the algebraic coordinates at every point; proved to form a complex atlas, Phi-free). Replaces bostLowerBoundPrinted (ZInQ.R3Residual.bostLowerBoundPrinted_of_an, with mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and uniformizationLeafAll_proof for T35; isAnStableHeight_iff proves the two heights equal, so the step R3 'clauses to biholomorphic' is a proved theorem).
